custodyProfile.uncertainty: The 2026-10-14 reserve composition pin and provider roster are retained; this 2026-10-15 custody review adds issuer-documented rights and independently pinned current custody/controls. At block 26197527, sole adapter 0x4f74895557bea2de5d51d8c06e944da92dbc8550 holds 7 Morpho supply positions totaling 13548188669278 raw USDC; idle 2824 plus those claims equals totalAssets 13548188672102 against 12860091198915665773935089 raw shares. Four known off-list residuals remain 1 raw USDC each, excluded from realAssets rather than asserted absent. All enumerated positions have zero borrowing and posted collateral. Segregated describes operational separation between the named vault/adapter positions, corroborating KPK's published and archived statement that assets are not pooled across its vaults; it does not mean holder-by-holder custody accounts, enforceable legal ring-fencing or segregation of every downstream collateral issuer's assets. KPK says it never holds depositor assets and asserts no outside pledge or lien. Its disclaimer names KPK Digital Assets Inc. as curator, excludes contractual obligations to holders, and places any contractual remedies under Morpho terms. No bankruptcy-remoteness legal opinion exists, so bankruptcyRemoteness stays unknown; operational separation is not insolvency priority. Lending vault USDC to Morpho borrowers is the product's capital reuse, already graded in wrapper allocation; it is not a separately established custodian rehypothecation permission or prohibition. The disclosure says borrower collateral is not reused, but that does not establish downstream collateral issuer/custodian reuse and recovery rights; rehypothecation stays unknown for the custody profile. The no-lien assertion is issuer-documented, not independently legally verified. Blockscout partial-source-verification caveat remains. The published at-least-30% liquidity target and questionnaire's unpinned Morpho API figures do not bound realization of the borrowed remainder; the whole-position liquidityHorizon stays unknown. Seed-capital leave-last is an issuer statement, not enforceable subordination or a funded backstop.
